title: Counting to 100 by Ones and Tens
short: Count by ones and by tens all the way to 100.
trouble: Children stall where the decade changes, saying "twenty-nine, twenty-ten."

blocks.html: You can count on from any number. Now let’s count all the way to 100! The hundred chart shows every number.

blocks.name: hundredchart
blocks.cap: The shaded squares are the tens: 10, 20, 30 … 100. Each row is one more ten.

blocks.html: After a number ending in 9 comes a new ten: 29, 30. Counting by tens goes 10, 20, 30 … 100.
The ones go 1 to 9, then a new ten starts. The ten words, twenty, thirty, forty and so on, tell which ten you are in.

blocks.title: A new ten
steps: 39 ends in 9, so a new ten comes next.

blocks.title: Counting by tens
steps: Each jump is one more ten.

blocks.html: Getting stuck where the ten changes, saying “twenty-nine, twenty-ten.” After 29 comes 30. On the chart, look at the next square.
For grown-ups: Count to 100 by tens with jumps or claps. Then practice the tricky spots by ones, like 27 to 33 and 57 to 63.
